name: test-support-go-test-library-evidence
description: A Go package carries test evidence where one of its files other than its test files imports the testing package or a package of github.com/google/go-cmp, github.com/onsi/ginkgo, github.com/onsi/gomega, github.com/stretchr/testify or gotest.tools, a package below one of those module paths included, so a package only tests reach that imports an assertion library is test-support code and its declarations a test calls are not reported. One that imports none is production code only tests use.
